weapon.d: If unit initiates combat, inflicts Atk/Spd-5 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.
If unit initiates combat, inflicts Atk/Spd-5 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.

At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 to unit during combat, and also, if no effect neutralizes penalties to foe's Atk/Spd/Def/Res, inflicts penalty on each of those stats during combat = 6 - current penalty on each of those stats (min: 0; calculates each stat penalty independently). If unit's HP ≥ 25% at start of combat, inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-6 on foe through its next action after combat. If foe's Range = 2, calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Atk.

a.d: If foe initiates combat, grants Atk+2 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Atk+4 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Atk+6 during combat.

c.d: If unit initiates combat, deals 3 damage to foes within 2 spaces of target after combat.
If unit initiates combat, deals 5 damage to foes within 2 spaces of target after combat.
If unit initiates combat, deals 7 damage to foes within 2 spaces of target after combat.
